title: CENTER & REAR ROOF INTERIOR TRIM
summary: Coupe (19437) headliner at the center roof bar (T-top center bar) and the rear roof: the center and rear headlining panels (see charts for trim colors) screwed to the roof bows, with clip nuts on the center bow, plus the screws at the garnish molding. The rear headlining is screwed up into the roof inner/outer bow and the center headlining overlaps it with an equal gap front and rear.

parts.name: CHART-HEADLINING CTR
parts.name_expanded: Headlining – center roof (T-top center bar); see trim chart

parts.name: CHART-HEADLINING REAR
parts.name_expanded: Headlining – rear roof; see trim chart

fastening.note: View A: screws [2] go up from below through the overlapping center headlining [1] and rear headlining [3] into clip nuts [4] on the center bow.
Main view: further screws [2] go up through the roof panel (rear) headlining into the roof structure, including one at the outer rear corner.

fastening.to: rear roof at the rear window opening
fastening.note: Screw [5] goes in horizontally at the rear of the headlining near the rear window edge.

fastening.to: front end of the center roof headlining, at the garnish molding
fastening.note: Screw [6] goes up from below through the bracket at the front of the headlining near the garnish molding.
View B: screw [7] goes up through rear headlining [3] into a .144/.148 dia hole in the bow, .17 and .65 from the edges.

notes: .120/.124 DIA HOLE (2) PLACES USE [3] AS TEMPLET
GAP TO BE EQUAL FRT & REAR
